name: calc_rpow_lt_rpow_swap_of_exp_le
statement: (x y : ℝ) (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ x) (hxy : x < y) : y ^ x < x ^ y
closed: ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx : Real.exp 1 ≤ x) (hxy : x < y), y ^ x < x ^ y
informal: For e ≤ x < y, yˣ < xʸ — log t / t is strictly decreasing on [e, ∞) (derivative (1 − log t)/t² < 0 for t > e), so log y / y < log x / x; exponentiate.
type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), Real.exp 1 ≤ x → x < y → y ^ x < x ^ y
